import os

# Load the spreadsheet
file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/53161/1_53161_input.xlsx'
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Step 1: Extract Agent Categories (rows 3-10, columns E-N)
# Agent names are in column E (column 5), categories 1-9 are in columns F-N (columns 6-14)
agent_categories = {}
for row in range(3, 11):  # rows 3-10
    agent_name = ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value
    if agent_name:
        categories = []
        for col in range(6, 15):  # columns F-N (6-14)
            val = ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value
            categories.append(1 if val == 1 else 0)
        agent_categories[agent_name] = categories

print("Agent Categories:")
for agent, cats in agent_categories.items():
    print(f"  {agent}: {cats}")

# Step 2: Extract Schedule (rows 13-20, columns A-D)
# Time intervals in column A (column 1), agents in columns B-D (columns 2-4)
schedule = []
for row in range(13, 21):  # rows 13-20
    time_interval = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    agents_scheduled = []
    for col in range(2, 5):  # columns B-D (2-4)
        agent = ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value
        if agent:
            agents_scheduled.append(agent)
    schedule.append((time_interval, agents_scheduled))

print("\nSchedule:")
for time, agents in schedule:
    print(f"  {time}: {agents}")

# Step 3: Calculate totals for each time interval and category
# Output goes to rows 22-29, columns F-N (6-14)
output_start_row = 22
for idx, (time_interval, agents_scheduled) in enumerate(schedule):
    output_row = output_start_row + idx
    
    # For each category (columns F-N, which are columns 6-14)
    for cat_idx in range(9):  # 9 categories
        output_col = 6 + cat_idx  # columns F-N
        
        # Sum the category values for all scheduled agents
        total = 0
        for agent in agents_scheduled:
            if agent in agent_categories:
                total += agent_categories[agent][cat_idx]
        
        # Write the total to the output cell
        ws.cell(row=output_row, column=output_col, value=total)

print("\nOutput written to rows 22-29, columns F-N")

# Save the modified workbook
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/53161_1_6f637e45/1_53161_output.xlsx'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"\nSaved to: {output_path}")

wb.close()
